readerCopy.summary: A direct conversation can clear a problem that has been taking far more mental energy than the actual solution requires.
readerCopy.body: A direct conversation can clear a problem that has been taking far more mental energy than the actual solution requires. When Mercury sextiles Mars, thought and action cooperate, helping you say the useful thing and move on it before another round of overthinking begins. Make the call, ask the question, send the correction, or tell somebody what needs to happen next. Deploy precision rather than volume to clear the bottleneck immediately. Make the exact request, secure the missing link, and regain your momentum without leaving bruised egos in your wake.
